_comment: Готовые SD-пресеты под услуги центра Энтузиаст. Агент выбирает пресет по preset_type, подставляет params.

presets.name: Релакс-массаж
presets.description: Женский портрет по пояс, расслабление, атмосфера спа
presets.style: realistic photo, warm tones, cozy spa atmosphere
presets.prompt: {gender}, lying on massage table, spa center, eyes closed, relaxed expression, soft warm lighting, candles, aroma diffuser, white towels, smooth skin, {angle}, cozy atmosphere, photorealistic, highly detailed, 8k, sharp focus
presets.negative_prompt: lowres, blurry, grainy, noise, bad anatomy, bad proportions, deformed, disfigured, distorted face, cloned face, asymmetrical face, bad hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, extra limbs, multiple limbs, fused fingers, mutated hands, watermark, signature, logo, text, caption, nudity, exposed breasts, underwear, blood, bruises, medical equipment, hospital

presets.name: Аппаратная процедура
presets.description: Аппарат, насадка, лицо в профиль, специалист в белом
presets.style: realistic photo, clinical clean, soft professional lighting
presets.prompt: {gender}, cosmetic procedure, beauty device, handheld applicator on {zone}, spa treatment room, patient lying on couch, eyes closed, relaxed, therapist in white uniform, soft clinical lighting, clean modern equipment, {angle}, photorealistic, highly detailed, sharp focus
presets.negative_prompt: lowres, blurry, bad anatomy, deformed face, distorted facial features, overexposed skin, red irritated skin, bruises, scars, acne, medical horror, syringes, blood, surgery, open wounds, extra limbs, extra fingers, mutated hands, watermark, signature, logo, text, gore, nudity

presets.name: Зона тела (без лица)
presets.description: Антицеллюлитный / массаж зоны, акцент на руках специалиста и коже
presets.style: realistic photo, warm neutral tones, professional spa
presets.prompt: 1 woman, lying on massage table, anti cellulite massage, therapist hands working on {zone}, focus on {zone}, professional spa room, warm lighting, clean white towels, smooth skin, close-up on treatment area, no face visible, photorealistic, highly detailed
presets.negative_prompt: lowres, blurry, bad anatomy, deformed body, distorted legs, extra limbs, extra fingers, cellulite exaggerated, bruises, scars, veins, wrinkles, fat folds, watermark, signature, logo, text, nudity, visible genitals, thong, underwear focus, blood, medical syringes, multiple limbs, fused fingers

presets.name: До/После (фигура)
presets.description: Сравнение тела от шеи до колен, нейтральный фон, без головы
presets.style: realistic photo, neutral studio background, even lighting
presets.prompt: before and after, 2 images, same {gender_noun}, front view body from neck to knees, weight loss result, slimmer waist, smoother skin, neutral studio background, even lighting, realistic body proportions, photorealistic, highly detailed, comparison layout
presets.negative_prompt: lowres, blurry, bad anatomy, distorted body, warped waist, extremely thin, anorexic, body horror, extra limbs, extra arms, extra legs, missing limbs, heavy cellulite, deep wrinkles, skin folds exaggerated, watermark, signature, logo, text, measurements overlay, underwear focus, nudity, visible nipples, thong, see-through clothes, blood, multiple limbs, fused fingers

presets.name: Эмоциональный портрет после процедуры
presets.description: Крупный план, взгляд в камеру, сияющая кожа, лёгкая улыбка
presets.style: realistic photo, soft studio light, healthy glow
presets.prompt: {gender}, portrait, close-up, looking at viewer, gentle smile, fresh skin, light natural makeup, soft studio lighting, spa background blurred, shallow depth of field, bokeh, healthy glow, {age}, photorealistic, highly detailed, 8k, sharp eyes
presets.negative_prompt: lowres, blurry, out of focus, bad anatomy, deformed face, distorted eyes, lazy eye, asymmetrical face, wrinkles exaggerated, acne, scars, dark eye circles, red eyes, oily skin shine, harsh shadows, watermark, signature, logo, text, heavy makeup, gothic style, horror, gore, nudity, extra fingers, mutated hands, fused fingers, multiple limbs
